```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(scales)
library(reshape2)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
outcome <- read.csv("outcome-of-care-measures.csv")
```
```{r}
outcomesel <- outcome[, c(11, 17, 23)]
colnames(outcomesel) <- c("Heart Attack", "Cardiac Arrest", "Pneumonia")
```
```{r}
molten <- melt(outcomesel, measure.vars = 1:3)
```
```{r}
s <- subset(molten, value != "Not Available" & value != "NaN")
s$value <- as.numeric(s$value)
```
```{r}
ggplot(s, aes(x = value)) +
  facet_grid(variable ~ .) +
  geom_histogram() +
  xlab("Ratio de muertes cada 30 días")
```
```{r}
hospital <- read.csv("hospital-data-1.csv")
outcome.hospital <- inner_join(outcome, hospital, by = "Provider.Number")
```
```{r}
outcome.hospital[, 11] <- as.numeric(outcome.hospital[, 11])
outcome.hospital[, 15] <- as.numeric(outcome.hospital[, 15])
outcome.hospital$Hospital.Ownership <- factor(outcome.hospital$Hospital.Ownership)
```
```{r}
ggplot(outcome.hospital, aes(x = outcome.hospital[, 15], y = outcome.hospital[, 11])) + geom_point() +
ggtitle("Ataques al corazón cada 30 días por tipo de hospital") +
xlab("Número de pacientes visitados") +
ylab("Ratio de muertes cada 30 días") +
geom_smooth(method = "lm") +
facet_wrap(~ Hospital.Ownership) +
theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))
```
